lw3654.title: SCVHistory.com LW3654 | William S. Hart | Color Strip Card ~1919.
lw3654.firstParagraphUnderImage: Actor William S. Hart is shown on a color strip card, 1⅜x2½ inches, ~1919 (between 1918 and 1921). The issuer is unknown; No. 26 in a series. Variety with "WILL S. HART" in right-slanting capital letters; Hart against a red background. Hart is wearing a plaid newsboy cap, which he often wore off-screen.
